usage_scope: explicit exploratory continuation of mixed-source donor transport to zero condensed inventory
source_reading_scope: Original Makela PDF and Septien JATS table were read in prior registered source reviews; original providers reverify those bytes and their facts/models at public use. No new source measurements are created here.

diffusivity.scope: Makela untreated paper-mill sludge apparent effective total-loss diffusivity, assigned to this single condensed inventory; below .30 and across 35-95 C frozen with unknown transfer error; no parallel gas/Darcy moisture path

closure.geometry: rho_d=md/(area*cell_width), exact and equal on both sides; ell=(width_left+width_right)/2; volume is total controlled slab volume, not pore fluid volume
closure.positive_low_low: K=A*rho_d*D/(M*ell); Llog=(WL-WR)/ln(WL/WR), equal-W limit W; C=join_muL/TL-join_muR/TR+hface*(1/TR-1/TL); n=K*((WL-WR)+Llog*C/R); H=hface*n
closure.positive_cross_join_or_source: Gamma is the positive secant of complete excess molar mu at exact arithmetic Tface; every traversed represented m/q segment must be positive; n=Tface*K/Gamma*(muL/TL-muR/TR+hface*(1/TR-1/TL))
closure.same_W_join: positive low-side RT/Wj and positive source-side derivative averaged explicitly; no false smooth Gamma claim
closure.single_zero: analytic n=K*(WL-WR), H=hface*n; chemical drive and positive-infinite instantaneous entropy use null with named limit
closure.double_zero: n=H=0 and no_exchange; no finite chemical potential or unique two-variable entropy limit asserted
closure.heat: hface is arithmetic full molar condensed-water enthalpy in a common actual water reference; independent conduction remains outside this face; no extra latent source

numerical_policy.exact: represented input/source algebra with exact rational W and arithmetic Tface
numerical_policy.log: log1p near equal positive W, log difference otherwise; numerical log error unknown
numerical_policy.low_low_readout: stable analytic drive retained separately from complete nominal mu readout drive; difference and actual rounded n/H entropy balance recorded
numerical_policy.finite_rates: reject nonzero-to-zero and overflow projections; reject negative or unresolved positive rounded entropy
numerical_policy.source_resolution: same-T/P positive source/cross-join states with nonzero dW require dmu*dW>0; preserve independent dmu-Gamma*dW residual; stable double-low-W drive is unchanged
numerical_policy.scope: instantaneous nominal face and shared rounded-rate checks, not full-step entropy or continuum convergence proof

runtime_binding: Exact LowMoistureSorptionStorage/point/inverse/phase classes, common actual WaterChemicalPotential reference, inventory correspondence, actual phase pure-liquid state and h/mu readouts. In-process correspondence, not authentication of arbitrary serialized objects.
zero_reference: Pure liquid at a dry state's T/P is a hypothetical standard state with no liquid inventory or volume
